user_request: Windows default selection must show MIDI channel waveforms, using configured SF2 internally.
changes: F8 Windows-default choice3 always selects internal synthesis; direct MIDI moved to explicit choice4 labeled no waveforms.

Existing VirtualMIDISynth config/single enabled font takes priority without relying on mapper preferred-ID result. Missing/ambiguous configured fonts raise error rather than silent DLS fallback; no VMS config uses Windows bank.
Actual bank filename displayed in track info; existing direct-route defaults migrate once.
Single EXE and prior16M event/large SF2 fixes retained.

full_CTest.stage: Before final button-label shortening only; packaged tests cover final EXE

tests.unit_policy: Choice4 external then choice3 internal; active configured SF2 selected and multiple-font error cannot silently return DLS.
tests.audio: dummy; no physical listening or external device notes; no user app changed

limitations: This synthesizes same SF2 internally; it is not captured/identical VirtualMIDISynth audio or BASS effects.
Only single active SF2 auto; layers/remapping require manual bank selection.
Reopen/select Windows-default again after bank configuration changes.
